title: Design System: Premium Properties / נכסים פרימיום

display.purpose: Home hero H1 only, white on the photo scrim. 40 / 60 / 72px.

headline.purpose: Listing H1 (36 / 48 / 60px) and page H1s on admin and the statement.

title.purpose: Section headings; 24px for panel, dialog and empty-state titles; 20px for form legends.

card-title.purpose: Listing card titles (one line) and the wordmark.

price.purpose: Heebo semibold tabular. 18px on cards, 36 / 48px on the listing header.

body-lead.purpose: Descriptions and statement paragraphs, max 65ch, line-height 1.9 in Hebrew.

body.purpose: Default text, inputs, selects. Line-height 1.7 in Hebrew.

meta.purpose: Type · city, fact labels, header controls, button text.

label.purpose: Badges, gallery counter, search-field captions. 13px is the Hebrew floor.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Floating panels only: hero search panel, dialogs, dropdown menus, focused skip link.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Hero photo settles on load. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: card-photo-zoom
motion.purpose: Listing card photo on hover. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: color-transition

components.css: .ds-card { display: block; width: 300px; direction: rtl; text-decoration: none; color: #1b1916; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Heebo, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #f3efe8, 0 0 0 6px #9a7440; } .ds-card-img { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d3c8b7, #a99e8f); transition: transform 700ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-img { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-card-badge { position: absolute; top: 12px; inset-inline-start: 12px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(27,25,22,0.9); color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; } .ds-card-title + .ds-card-meta { margin-top: 4px; } .ds-card-meta { margin: 16px 0 0; font-size: 15px; color: #6b6257; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-title { margin: 16px 0 0; font-family: 'Frank Ruhl Libre', Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.375; text-decoration-color: #9a7440; text-underline-offset: 6px; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { text-decoration-line: underline; } .ds-card-price { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The site behaves like a brokerage's printed listing sheet laid on limestone: a real photograph at full scale, a Hebrew serif headline set large, and the facts below it in a measured row separated by hairline rules. Nothing is boxed for decoration. Listing cards are a photo with type set under it, not a card with a border and a shadow. The only filled dark blocks are structural: the footer, the contact panel on a listing, and the primary action.

The world is warm and quiet. Warm near-black ink and limestone neutrals carry almost everything; brass is the single accent and appears as a thin line (active-nav underline, hover underline, focus ring, icon tint) far more often than as a fill. Olive exists only to tell a rental from a sale. There is no blue anywhere in the brand layer; any blue on screen comes from the photographs.

The system is Hebrew-first. The document opens as `lang="he" dir="rtl"`, every layout uses logical properties (start/end, `ps-`, `me-`), directional icons mirror in RTL, and the Hebrew type scale is enforced globally. English is a full second language, not a fallback. Credibility comes from restraint and real detail: no invented statistics, testimonials or claims, and demo data is labelled as demo.
keyCharacteristics: Photography leads; the brand recedes to ink, limestone and a brass line.
Hebrew-first RTL with logical properties and a dedicated Hebrew type scale.
Serif headlines (Frank Ruhl Libre), one sans for everything else including numerals (Heebo).
Hairline stone rules instead of card boxes; near-square 4px corners.
Every target at least 44px; every focus a visible brass ring.
Israeli formats: ₪ after the number in Hebrew, dd.MM.yyyy dates, local 03-… phone display.

rules.name: The One Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass is the only accent. It appears mostly as a 1–2px line or an icon tint; filled brass is reserved for the Exclusive badge (dark step) and the advisor monogram.

rules.name: The Dark-Step Text Rule
rules.body: Any brass that is read as text on a light ground uses brass-dark (#7a5a2b). Brass (#9a7440) is for lines, rings and icons only.

rules.name: The No-Blue Rule
rules.body: No blue in the brand layer: no blue buttons, links, focus rings, badges or gradients.

rules.name: The Status-by-Fill Rule
rules.body: All status badges share one frame; the fill alone separates them: sale = ink, rent = olive, Exclusive = brass-dark, Featured = transparent with a stone outline.

rules.name: The Hebrew Floor Rule
rules.body: In RTL, no text is smaller than 13px (`text-xs` is lifted to 13px/20px), body line-height is 1.7, `leading-tight` becomes 1.4 and `leading-relaxed` 1.9, word-spacing is +0.05em.

rules.name: The No-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Hebrew is never letter-spaced; any tracking utility is reset to normal under `dir="rtl"`. No uppercase-tracked labels.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Prices, counts, areas, phone numbers and the gallery counter use tabular figures so they align and don't jitter as filters change.

rules.name: The Israeli Format Rule
rules.body: Prices go through `Intl.NumberFormat('he-IL', {currency: 'ILS'})`, which puts ₪ after the number in Hebrew ("8,500,000 ₪", rent adds "לחודש"); English shows "₪8,500,000 / mo". Dates use he-IL 2-digit day/month (dd.MM.yyyy). Phones are stored as +972 and shown locally as 03-… in Hebrew, set `dir="ltr"`; the `tel:` link keeps the international form.

rules.name: The Logical Properties Rule
rules.body: Layout uses start/end, `ps-`/`pe-`, `ms-`/`me-` and `text-start`/`text-end` only. Directional icons (arrows, chevrons, login) flip with `rtl:-scale-x-100`.

rules.name: The 44px Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element is at least 44px tall (`min-h-11`); primary call actions and gallery arrows are 48px.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this floats above a photo or the page". Inline content, cards and the contact panel stay flat.

rules.name: The 4px Rule
rules.body: Corners are 4px (2px for badges). No pill buttons, no 12–16px rounded cards.

dos: **Do** let a real listing photograph carry the first viewport; name it with the caption plate.
**Do** use ink, limestone and stone for almost everything, with brass as a line or tint (One Brass Rule).
**Do** use brass-dark (#7a5a2b) for any brass text on light grounds and keep all text at ≥4.5:1.
**Do** set headlines in Frank Ruhl Libre bold and everything else, including numbers, in Heebo with tabular figures.
**Do** keep Hebrew at 13px minimum, line-height 1.7, with no letter-spacing.
**Do** use logical properties and mirror directional icons in RTL.
**Do** format prices with Intl he-IL (₪ after the number in Hebrew), dates as dd.MM.yyyy, and phones as local 03-… in Hebrew with `dir="ltr"`.
**Do** make every target at least 44px and give every focusable element a visible 2px brass ring (brass-light on ink).
**Do** separate content with 1px stone-300 hairlines and keep corners at 4px (2px for badges).
**Do** label demo data as demo (footer note, statement draft note, placeholder WhatsApp that dials nothing).
donts: **Don't** use blue anywhere in the brand layer.
**Don't** add kickers or eyebrows (small uppercase labels above headings).
**Don't** invent statistics, counts, testimonials or claims; the only numbers shown are real listing data.
**Don't** wrap listings in bordered, shadowed, heavily rounded cards.
**Don't** add shadows to inline content; shadows are for floating panels only.
**Don't** use physical left/right properties or unmirrored arrows.
**Don't** add a second accent colour; olive is a status colour for rentals, not decoration.
